name: Pinterest

field_reviews.reason: Pinterest API v5 requires an OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with token refresh; the Standard-access upgrade review explicitly verifies 'you are sending users through the OAuth flow appropriately'.
OAuth 2.0 authorization code is the only documented auth for API v5; no API-key or client-credentials alternative found on developers.pinterest.com.

Two-tier model confirmed live at developers.pinterest.com/docs/key-concepts/access-tiers/: Trial access (granted after a routine business-day review) includes sandbox entities (Pins/boards visible only to creator), 1,000 req/day cap and api-sandbox.pinterest.com; Standard (production) requires a manual upgrade review with a video recording demonstrating the OAuth flow. Both tiers free. The trap of recording sandbox as production was checked: the draft correctly separates the tiers and correctly notes Trial itself needs a lightweight review.
v5 covers pins, boards, ads, audiences, catalogs, analytics and trends per the access-tiers capability table - broad is accurate.
API v5 is REST-only; no GraphQL or vendor MCP endpoint found on developers.pinterest.com.

Composio PINTEREST_ADS toolkit confirmed in the live docs.composio.dev/toolkits catalog (10 tools, OAUTH2, not Composio-managed) and at composio.dev/toolkits/pinterest_ads; no general-purpose Pinterest toolkit and no official Pinterest vendor MCP found in independent searches.
Trial access with sandbox is obtainable within about a business day and supports full development; only production rollout waits on the Standard review.
Standard (production) access requires a manual video-demo review; community reports confirm rejections for not demonstrating the full OAuth flow, so this is the correct primary blocker.

notes: Re-checked access tiers with special attention to the sandbox-vs-production trap: draft's sandbox_self_serve_production_gated is accurate - Trial is near-self-serve (routine daily review) with sandboxed Pins, Standard is a gated manual review requiring an OAuth video demo. Draft evidence URL developers.pinterest.com/docs/key-concepts/access-tiers/ confirmed live and matching. Composio PINTEREST_ADS toolkit independently confirmed in the catalog.
